answer: The declaration is a vine header, so 3362 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Fingerprints are counted in meadow, thus the distribution is public, and basalt lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. Slashing removes 27 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
